anchors.statement: Each exact pin, tilde restriction, or extra upper bound on a third-party dependency MUST explain its known incompatibility in the owning manifest.
anchors.quote: Declare the allowed range as `>=` a reasonable, tested floor, instead of `=x.y.z`, `~x.y` or a single 0.x minor. Use an upper bound only where a known break requires one, and say why in a comment.
anchors.context: randlee-authored GitHub issue #133, Requested change item 2 and Done when: https://github.com/randlee/sc-runtime/issues/133. This candidate captures justification of extra restrictions; it does not adopt the older blanket >= prescription.
anchors.scope: Adds or retains a restrictive third-party requirement in any published crate, generated template, or test manifest. Extra upper bound means tighter than the normal Cargo compatibility line; internal path package versions and a negative compatibility fixture with an explicit reason are distinguishable.
anchors.deterministic_check: Plan: each retained extra restriction names the incompatibility and the owning manifest comment. Development: enumerate exact/tilde/extra-upper requirements and inspect comments for the affected API, links conflict, toolchain limit, or deliberate negative-test compatibility boundary.

fail: The manifest caps rmcp below an unpublished major with no known break or explanatory comment.
